name: Mixed subjects
blurb: Sites that cover a bit of everything, for when you want one place to start rather than twelve.

name: Maths
blurb: Number, times tables and the maths that turns up later in exams. Practice, explanations and the odd game.

name: English & literacy
blurb: Reading, writing, phonics and spelling, from first sounds to essays.

name: Science & nature
blurb: Experiments, the natural world, and the science that ends up on an exam paper.

name: Computing & digital
blurb: Coding, digital skills and staying safe online.

name: History
blurb: People, places and what happened when, whether at the kitchen table or on a day out.

name: Geography
blurb: Maps, weather, countries and the world outside the front door.

name: Languages
blurb: Learning another language at home, including ones nobody in the house speaks yet.

name: Arts & music
blurb: Art, design, music and drama. For making things, not just reading about them.

name: Life skills & wellbeing
blurb: Money, cooking, careers and looking after yourself: the things a school timetable tends to squeeze out.

name: Exams & qualifications
blurb: Revision, sitting exams as a private candidate, and finding somewhere to sit them.

name: Groups & meetups
blurb: Places to meet other home ed families, online and in person.

name: Support & advice
blurb: Getting started, the law, the local authority and SEND. Help for the grown-ups.
